an3.30:1.1: 30 tayome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an3.30:1.3: avakujjapañño puggalo ucchaṅgapañño puggalo puthupañño puggalo.
an3.30:1.5: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ārāmaṃ gantā hoti abhikkhaṇaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ santike dhammassavanāya
an3.30:1.6: tassa bhikkhū dhammaṃ desenti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsenti
an3.30:1.7: so tasmiṃ āsane nisinno tassā kathāya nevādiṃ manasikaroti na majjhaṃ manasikaroti na pariyosānaṃ manasikaroti
an3.30:1.8: vuṭṭhitopi tamhā āsanā tassā kathāya nevādiṃ manasikaroti na majjhaṃ manasikaroti na pariyosānaṃ manasikaroti
an3.30:1.9: seyyathāpi bhikkhave kumbho nikkujjo tatra udakaṃ āsittaṃ vivaṭṭati no saṇṭhāti
an3.30:1.10: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco puggalo ārāmaṃ gantā hoti abhikkhaṇaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ santike dhammassavanāya
